title: Episode About the Expansion of the Khalsa Panth

blocks.text: Those who understood the discipline and wisdom of the Khalsa left worldly administration and joined the Satguru’s Panth. (50)
Day and night the Panth kept growing: men brought their sons and grandsons into it, and the radiance of the Khalsa increased greatly. (51)
Whoever had suffered loss in trade, property, or social standing found a place in the Khalsa and no longer remained abandoned. (52–53)
